# Clariant

> Clariant is a global specialty chemicals company delivering innovative solutions for sustainable industrial applications across catalysts, additives, and specialty polymers.

Clariant operates across multiple business units serving automotive, construction, oil & gas, and adhesives industries. The company emphasizes sustainability, ESG commitments, and technological innovation through products like Licocene Terra and blue hydrogen catalysts.

## Key Topics

- Specialty Chemicals

## Sustainability & ESG

- [Sustainability](https://www.clariant.com/en/Sustainability): Clariant's sustainability strategy, ESG objectives, and climate commitments
- [Blue Hydrogen Solutions](https://www.clariant.com/Corporate/Main-Content/Promoted/Blue-hydrogen-The-shortcut-to-a-low-carbon-economy): Blue hydrogen solutions and industrial decarbonization with Clariant catalysts
- [Licocene Terra Sustainable Polymers](https://www.clariant.com/Corporate/Main-Content/Promoted/Licocene-Terra): Licocene Terra sustainable polymer solution for renewable carbon adhesives
- [Antimony Oxide Alternatives](https://www.clariant.com/Corporate/Main-Content/Promoted/Why-Antimony-no-longer-works-for-modern-adhesives): Sustainable alternatives to antimony oxide for adhesives and flame retardants
